base_transform.reason: Normalize legacy neutral dimensions into metres and place the comparison origin at the intended joint-centre height; a display/input frame convention, not an anatomical inference about the old source.

reference_sources.role: Skeletal landmark relationships, not numerical population measurements.
Artist proportion guide: roughly quarter-height femur; femoral head is distinct from lateral trochanter/shaft; inward thigh direction. Approximate guide, not anthropometry.

Professional stylized upright animal-body reference: animal character and stylized anatomy coexist. No numerical coordinates are extracted; the experimental proportions below are our explicit design hypothesis, not Disney measurements or an architecture adoption.

cases.role: Ordinary-adult lower-body structural calibration, not a full human fixture or population coverage.
cases.reason: Adult-like pelvis and femur proportions; separate medial/proximal hip joint from lateral/subtrochanteric thigh-start proxy. Preserve inherited upper context after the declared frame normalization; it is not newly calibrated anatomy.
cases.uncertainty: Hand-estimated reference interpretation: joint position about +/-0.02 m; thigh/pelvic landmarks about +/-0.025 m; skin dimensions about +/-0.03 m. Not measured-subject or clinical data, and no post-render adjustment is allowed.
cases.station_reason: Pelvic envelope is centred near the acetabular region, widest below the iliac crest; abdomen ascends above it. These remain envelope stations, not newly renamed bone landmarks. Depth includes posterior soft-tissue allowance. Values are one approximate adult-like calibration hypothesis.
cases.hip_radii_reason: Approximate proximal-thigh skin half-width/depth and vertical support scale; r_y remains a construction influence scale, not a bone length or hip-joint radius.
cases.attachment_reason: Thigh start is a proximal shaft/profile-start proxy, lateral and inferior to joint centre; knees are modestly medial. Joint-to-knee distance about 0.43 m is close to a quarter of nominal stature. T-to-knee is deliberately shorter and is not substituted for femur length.

cases.role: Stylized upright mammal lower-body calibration with broader pelvis and shorter femur relative to stature; no species-universal anatomy claim.
cases.reason: Equally important intended body family, tested through the SAME construction. Retain coherent upright pelvic support while allowing a broader/shorter proximal-leg design. Distal stance, animal head, fur and tail are absent, not claimed tested.
cases.uncertainty: Artist-design hypothesis rather than biological anthropometry: landmark positions about +/-0.03 m; proportional design allowances about +/-20%. It is not a numeric reconstruction of any named film character.
cases.station_reason: Deliberately broader and deeper upright pelvic envelope than the human case, while preserving the crest/joint/thigh ordering; stations remain skin-envelope controls, not skeletal landmarks.
cases.hip_radii_reason: Broader proximal soft-tissue envelope for this stylized case, paired with a shorter thigh; no local mesh repair or species branch.
cases.attachment_reason: Distinct lateral/inferior thigh start, modest inward and forward knee direction, joint-to-knee about 0.356 m. A stylized shorter femur is intentional; future distal anatomy must not be inferred from this local experiment.

interpretation.reference_landmarks: Diagnostic targets only. J is NOT executable in this frozen generator; do not smuggle J into centre or claim J-to-skin causality.
interpretation.skin_bifurcation: Observed connected-section transition to two disjoint thigh contours, not a hip centre, source landmark, or exact universal crotch plane.
interpretation.old_containment: Original individual-side ray gate and rejected verdict are preserved. New joined-surface cross-sections diagnose placement only; they do not retroactively pass the old candidate.
interpretation.stop: Stop after one set and comparison even if proportions improve. No tuning or shape repair. If independent executable joint/landmark relations require code changes, report that obstruction explicitly.
